title: FREE Edgar Mitchell experiencer study: humanlike beings and friendly contacts
summary: Jesse Michels tells of FREE Edgar Mitchell experiencer study: humanlike beings and friendly contacts, about study published with about 3,500 respondents, now about 5,000 at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
